conventions: px = reference-image pixels, x right, y down, integer = pixel centre. Angles in image space: 0 deg = +x, positive = clockwise on screen. method 'measured' = computed from the masks/particles by scripts/reference_masks.py; 'read' = placed by eye on 4-8x zoomed crops. uncertainty_px is a 1-sigma-ish radius, not a hard bound.

index_tip.note: extreme silhouette pixel along 20 deg (distal phalanx direction)

pinky_tip.note: extreme silhouette pixel along 185 deg; the little finger is curled under the palm and points back toward the wrist

thumb_tip.note: thumb tip is not a silhouette extreme (the ring finger emerges from behind it); read as the distal end of the nail outline, which faces the viewer

index_mcp.note: knuckle bump where the back-of-hand line turns down into the index finger (575-590, 250-285); joint centre half a finger-thickness inside the dorsal edge

index_pip.note: dorsal bump at (683,322); centre halfway to the underside (~368)

index_dip.note: change of direction of the dorsal edge at (745,378)

middle_mcp.note: where the middle finger's outer edge leaves the index underside; hidden by the index finger

middle_pip.note: between the bend of the outer edge at (650,390) and the inner notch at (604,404)

ring_mcp.note: hidden under the palm's shaded underside

ring_pip.note: bend where the ring finger's outer edge turns down-left below the gap apex (604,404); inner edge hidden by the thumb

ring_dip.note: nail base on the ring finger

pinky_mcp.note: behind the thumb; inferred from where the little finger emerges

pinky_pip.note: little finger emerges from behind the thumb

pinky_dip.note: mid-length of the visible little finger

thumb_cmc.note: base of the thumb's outer edge above the palm heel; not drawn as a feature

thumb_mcp.note: thenar bulge on the outer edge

thumb_ip.note: nail base; the thumb nail faces the viewer

wrist.note: midpoint of the wrist cross-section from the start of the dorsal bump (262,136) to the start of the palm-heel curve (292,256), both anchor points on the silhouette

forearm_top_edge_deg.note: line fit to the mask's top edge, x 60..250

forearm_bottom_edge_deg.note: line fit to the mask's bottom edge, x 60..250

wrist_axis_deg.note: forearm axis at the wrist = bisector of the two forearm contour lines (image space: 0 = +x, positive = clockwise on screen, i.e. pointing down-right). The contours converge, so the forearm tapers toward the wrist.

hand_axis_deg.note: wrist centre -> middle MCP (derived from read points)

index_tip.note: outermost particle pixel along 205 deg (up-left, toward the contact)

thumb_tip.note: outermost particle along 175 deg; the thumb points left below the index

middle_tip.note: outermost particle along 95 deg; this finger curls down from the loop at (905-960, 650-700)

pinky_tip.note: no separate little finger is readable; the lower palm contour (1000-1080, 695-725) is the most likely place; treat as unmeasured

index_mcp.note: where the index finger band meets the dense palm mesh

index_pip.note: one third of the band length from the MCP; no articulation visible in the particles

index_dip.note: not visible; placed along the band

thumb_cmc.note: not readable: the thumb metacarpal is inside the palm; anatomical guess between the thumb MCP and the wrist

thumb_mcp.note: where the thumb band widens into the palm

middle_pip.note: left end of the loop, where the finger turns down

wrist.note: centre of the narrowest cross-section of the density silhouette between x 1150 and 1320 (measured perpendicular to the forearm axis); the particle edge is soft, hence the large uncertainty

wrist_axis_deg.note: line fit to the mid-points of the density silhouette's vertical extent for x 1150..1320 (before the cut); image space, 0 = +x, positive = down-right; points from hand to elbow

index_tip_gap_px.note: distance between left index_tip and right index_tip; the uncertainty is dominated by the particle tip (3 px)

silhouette_gap_px.note: closest approach of the two silhouettes
